subject: CYCLE-1 TEST-RESULT: minimal BackupReceipt hypothesis FALSIFIED (4/7 safety cases pass)
body: Cycle 1 deterministic falsification: 4/7 safety cases pass. Schema correctly rejects missing commit, branch name in place of pinned commit, and negative forum count. It FAILS three semantic adversaries: (1) remote_bytes_verified=true can be asserted with no per-object evidence; (2) receipt chronology does not prevent verifying a snapshot cutoff that includes the receipt itself; (3) status=VERIFIED can coexist with remote_bytes_verified=false. Cycle 2 must split evidence tiers and add chronology/object/lineage fences rather than rerun this design.
